# Calculator.net

> Free online calculators spanning math, finance, fitness, health, science, and everyday conversions.

Calculator.net provides a large catalog of browser-based calculators with quick inputs, instant results, and explanatory content. The site is organized by topic areas and includes both broad category hubs and individual calculators for common personal, academic, and professional tasks.

## Main Collections
- [Free Online Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/): Homepage listing major calculator categories and popular tools.
- [Financial Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/financial-calculator.html): Hub for loans, mortgages, investing, retirement, and other money calculators.
- [Fitness and Health Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/fitness-and-health-calculator.html): Hub for BMI, calorie, pregnancy, body fat, and health-related tools.
- [Math Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/math-calculator.html): Hub for algebra, fractions, percentages, random numbers, and geometry calculators.
- [Other Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/other-calculator.html): Hub for date, time, age, GPA, and miscellaneous everyday calculators.
- [Physics Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/physics-calculator.html): Hub for motion, force, energy, pressure, and electricity calculators.
- [Chemistry Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/chemistry-calculator.html): Hub for molarity, molecular weight, dilution, and concentration calculators.
- [Conversion Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/conversion-calculator.html): Hub for unit conversions including length, area, volume, temperature, and data.

## Mortgage, Loans, and Debt
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/mortgage-calculator.html): Estimate monthly mortgage payments with taxes, insurance, PMI, and amortization.
- [Refinance Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/refinance-calculator.html): Compare refinancing scenarios, savings, and break-even timing.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/loan-calculator.html): Calculate payments, total interest, and schedules for common loan types.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/auto-loan-calculator.html): Estimate car loan payments including taxes, fees, trade-ins, and rebates.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/amortization-calculator.html): Generate amortization schedules with payment breakdowns and payoff timelines.
- [Interest Rate Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/interest-rate-calculator.html): Solve for loan interest rate from payment, term, and principal.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/debt-payoff-calculator.html): Compare debt repayment strategies and estimate payoff dates.
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/personal-loan-calculator.html): Estimate monthly payments and borrowing costs for unsecured personal loans.

- [Investment Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/investment-calculator.html): Project investment growth with contributions, returns, and compounding assumptions.

- [Finance Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/finance-calculator.html): Solve time-value-of-money variables such as PV, FV, rate, and payment.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/retirement-calculator.html): Estimate retirement savings needs, income, and portfolio longevity.
- [401K Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/401k-calculator.html): Project 401(k) balances with employer match and annual contributions.
- [Roth IRA Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/roth-ira-calculator.html): Estimate Roth IRA growth and compare long-term retirement outcomes.
- [Annuity Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/annuity-calculator.html): Calculate present value, future value, and payout scenarios for annuities.

- [Budget Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/budget-calculator.html): Compare income and expenses to estimate savings or deficits.

- [Random Number Generator](https://www.calculator.net/random-number-generator.html): Generate random integers within a specified range.
- [Standard Deviation Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/standard-deviation-calculator.html): Compute standard deviation and related descriptive statistics.

- [Exponent Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/exponent-calculator.html): Evaluate powers and exponential expressions.
- [Log Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/log-calculator.html): Solve logarithms with configurable bases and values.

- [Kinetic Energy Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/kinetic-energy-calculator.html): Calculate kinetic energy from mass and velocity.
- [Pressure Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/pressure-calculator.html): Solve pressure from force and area values.

- [Dilution Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/dilution-calculator.html): Calculate concentrations and volumes for dilution problems.
